sources.title: Visa
sources.officialityEvidence: Current Armenian MFA consular guidance links to the official eVisa system and publishes the temporary residence-permit exemption.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Temporary exemption starts July 1, 2026 to July 1, 2027.

sources.title: Countries whose citizens may apply only with an invitation
sources.officialityEvidence: Current Armenian MFA consular list of visitor-visa applicants limited to a mission or consular post and an invitation.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Only at diplomatic representations or consular posts and with invitation only.

sources.title: E-Visa Issuance System: document types
sources.officialityEvidence: The MFA Visa page links to evisa.mfa.am; this live endpoint lists the E-Visa system's accepted document types, including ordinary PASSPORT.

sources.title: E-Visa Issuance System: live eligibility checker
sources.officialityEvidence: The MFA-linked live E-Visa system returns the eligibility result for selected citizenship, ordinary PASSPORT, and tourism/relatives purpose.

policies.title: Armenian citizenship
policies.summary: An Armenian ordinary passport belongs to an Armenian citizen and is outside the foreign visitor-visa schedule.
conditions: Does not decide dual-national document choice, residence, work, exit, transit, security, or individual border treatment.

policies.title: Ordinary passports returned as visa-free by the live MFA checker
policies.summary: For an ordinary PASSPORT and tourism/relatives purpose, the current MFA E-Visa eligibility endpoint returns ALLOW_WITHOUT_VISA for these passports.
conditions: The checked route is ordinary PASSPORT (document type 167) and visitor purpose TOURISM_RELATIVES; it does not decide non-ordinary documents, work, residence, transit, or admission discretion.
The separate residence-permit programme is not this nationality-only result: it requires the stated six-month-valid qualifying permit and is active from 1 July 2026 to 1 July 2027.

policies.title: Ordinary passports returned as eVisa-eligible by the live MFA checker
policies.summary: For an ordinary PASSPORT and tourism/relatives purpose, the current MFA E-Visa eligibility endpoint returns ALLOWED_FOR_EVISA for these non-exempt, non-invitation-listed passports.
conditions: The live response is an advance electronic-visa route for ordinary PASSPORT and TOURISM_RELATIVES; it is not an arrival-visa classification even where a separate API field mentions border processing.

The temporary residence-permit exemption is conditional on a qualifying physical/sticker permit with at least six months' validity and ends 1 July 2027; it does not replace the passport-only baseline.

policies.title: Ordinary passports returned as consulate-only
policies.summary: The current MFA E-Visa eligibility endpoint returns ONLY_CONSULATE for these ordinary-passport tourism/relatives queries.
conditions: Sudan and Togo also appear on the MFA's published invitation-only list. Kosovo is consulate-only in the live checker but is not named on that list.
This is not a classification for diplomatic, official, service, refugee, alien, transit, residence, work, or case-specific documents and purposes.
